chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Rifāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who forgot to perform ruku' until he had performed sajdah and stood up. He said: He starts over.

key_terms.يَرْكَعَ: to perform ruku' (the bowing in prayer)
key_terms.يَسْتَقْبِلُ: he begins again or restarts the prayer
key_terms.يَقُومَ: to stand up after the prostration

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the ruku' in salat (prayer) until after sajdah and standing up?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the ruku' in salat (prayer) until after performing sajdah and rising. The Imam عليه السلام states that he must restart the prayer, indicating the essential nature of ruku' within the prayer.
